notes.title: New environments and cyborgs for Cyborg Arena 2 !
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/4dced07752bfec53a8c5fbb0a79b1b677dc6e639.png
A large update has been released for Cyborg Arena 2, formerly known as Cyborg Arena UE4, the sequel of Cyborg Arena !

It includes the release of many new missions set in new environments  and more variety of cyborgs to fight!


4 kind of cyborgs are now present in the game to fight ! The Mega Cyborg, Strong Cyborg, Medium Cyborg and Zombie Cyborg !

Among the missions which were available in the first release (Cyborg Wasteland and Forest), 4 new environments were added !

DESERT
A semi arid desert with canyons and abandoned wooden shacks surrounded by cyborgs fortifications all along the path which goes to the only motorway!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/589e17766f6b7fd7ace44ed5e5f955c9e0161597.jpg
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/69008ac70e949e531a779f90bfe46202152e94c1.jpg
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/ae7897111cf1db2a953964b21e52f843385b4689.jpg

SLUMS
A tropical small village made of makeshift materials with cyborg fortifications all around to destroy.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/b9ce1684d576ad86b5eaf6ca96ae1798272f26b5.jpg
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/fbff4f44e4f45ff9cb03c87579ccb526b95ce6a3.jpg

ABANDONED TOWN
A small abandoned town covered with vegetation and surrounded by a dense forest populated of cyborgs and cyborg antennas.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/e936fcc6945b81a7fa0976ede5360d981bb71511.jpg
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/7e5354feb734fd26389bbdc5fd130d0e7fb76266.jpg

DESERT TOWN
A small town consisting of gas station, a motel and caravans on an arid desert connected with roads coming from various sides with cyborgs camps all around.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/6fc4e173ee2f425dd350a4be5b6b0a460fe21333.jpg
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/25326b4d365a0c646dc873f85e84ba3bb6694328.jpg

FOREST
A large country side place made of forest and plains with occasional farms and cyborgs installations hidden all around.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/a8244c5118478e5aef4af3bde90c21c26ecbce7c.jpg
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/90bae04e1eb1c097f45b730d56b40be8ab9a5877.jpg

CYBORG WASTELAND
A vast mountain desert with series of cyborgs fortified lines and antennas to assault and destroy!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/43943f399c88a4400bcf8d74dfc0ac1b1a76a8d2.jpg
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/3f9bc0fa7d882f6cc8b119ecea0055619462b3ae.jpg

A new trailer has been released to showcase the new content !
https://youtu.be/f52YWzFHO-4

This content has been added to the current release and is now available!

I hope you enjoyed this news!
Devdan

notes.title: Huge update for Zombie Road Rider! New maps and new zombies!
notes.content:
Hi people!

Zombie Road Rider has received a huge update that was on the work for some times now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175640/Zombie_Road_Rider/

Actually, the game has received a series of updates since the last news that was posted last year ago! So what is new?

A full new environment to play! The City Downtown ! Set in an environment made of skyscrapers and large roads, save the survivors who are running around and bring them to the safe house!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/95a0d1b7264481b6ac5e137bf3a7d2fe666b76aa.jpg

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/8f4e97a8c6bfae9a50ea725db8a7de4d3c9d0064.jpg

Another new environment, the Industrial Town! Set in narrow streets with old industrial style buildings, largely populated with fully physics-based props, obstacles and zombies to road ride!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/98f1e6fe837711a742a3775547dfccf23bc79310.jpg

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/fee8a8ddef73791dcacdc55f7d52fc7fca266e03.jpg

The Factory, a modern industrial type place with barricades and zombies to destroy!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/ade6a5df7052809be50173755ebab3f195d6ac41.jpg

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/a7e51c4dc1321136d3d203c7e5a49f4ee1aa8802.jpg

Another one main new aspect of the game is that +30 zombies were added to replace the old classic one, so that the game has more variety of characters!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/d026c4dfa1436d565e546f9a344a423bbf313c46.jpg

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/79c36fe1d10ef8ab1a5221af2a1626267cdd9578.jpg

Physics of the cars and vehicles were reworked to feel more enjoyable and powerful against the obstacles and zombies on the road. Improvements were made on the graphics and the optimisation of the game to have it run more smoothly. The menu and user interface was also reworked to be more intuitive and easier to use.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qe6t-gvPVg

The environments that were added have support for both rescue and freeride game mode!

So this pretty sum up all what you will find in this large update! I hope you will enjoy!

Best,
Devdan
